notes: Held-out plan added 2026-10-29 to test generalisation: a 98-page 2007 watershed implementation plan organised by management action rather than by key element, with fishery, cormorant, lake-level and alligator actions no tuning plan has. Drafted by Claude from the PDF text, page by page, before any extraction of this plan was run. Labelled on the pages of chapter 5 that describe the management actions; page 57 (potential activities not committed to by anyone) is left out. Education events in the action lists (the Sewage Summit, educating landowners) are outreach, as the category definitions say.
